_about: How Scout scores and filters listings. Every version of Scout reads this file. Edit the numbers, or use the tuning page (http://localhost:8787/tune) to try changes on a saved search first. Scores are clamped to 0-100.

price._help: Points for the total price, set by how the request talks about money. `cap` = 'up to X' (the default), `cheaper` = 'the less the better', `range` = 'around X' or 'between X and Y'. Each band is [share of the budget, points]; prices between two steps get a blend of the two, so every saving counts a little. In `range` mode every price inside the range gets `insideRange`; prices below the range get the `belowRange` bands, measured against the bottom of the range, because much cheaper usually means a smaller or worse place.

walk._help: Walk to the nearest station, measured against the walking limit in the request (10 min if none is given). Each band is [share of the limit, points]: with a 10-minute limit, up to 5 min = +25, up to 7 = +18, up to 9 = +10, 10 = +4. Full points always cover at least `fullWithinAtLeastMin` minutes, because Airbnb blurs locations by about that much.

reviewCount._help: How many reviews a place has is the main trust signal: a place with no reviews loses points, so it ranks below even a so-so place with 10 reviews. Each band is [at least this many reviews, points]. Multiplied when the request says reviews matter.

rating._help: Airbnb ratings run high, so 4.5 counts as neutral. Above it a place earns `perStarAbove` per star (4.9 = +12); below it it loses `perStarBelow` per star (4.2 = -12, 4.0 = -20, 3.0 = -60). Only counts once a place has at least `minReviews` reviews.

reviewIssue._help: Each recurring problem in the reviews (dirt, bugs, mould, noise, not as described...).

seriousFlag._help: Serious red flags: description contradicts the title, host on site in an 'entire place', scam or safety reports.

centrality._help: London tube zones, when the request prefers central (most do). Zones 3+ get 0.

safety._help: Street crime around the station compared with the other listings in the same search (police data).

arrival._help: Late arrivals: a quicker airport-to-door trip earns up to `max`. Full points within `fullWithinMin`, losing 1 point every `losePointEveryMin` minutes after that.

rules._help: What drops a listing, and what makes it a near miss instead of a pick. `walkNearMissUpToShare`: a walk up to this share of the limit (1.6 = 16 min on a 10-minute limit) is a near miss, longer is dropped. `nearMissBelowRating`: a place rated under this (with enough reviews to count) can't be a pick. `muchCheaperFlagBelowMedianShare`: a place under this share of the typical price in the same search gets a 'check carefully' flag.

overBudgetNearMissUpTo._help: How far over budget is still a near miss, per budget mode ('strict' = 'absolute max', 'no more than').
